output.summary: The claim can be appealed by referencing the sleep‑study pre‑auth clause and including the retroactive authorization request. Prior precedents for inpatient, MRI, or earlier sleep‑study rulings do not apply.

items.text: As the claim is appeal‑viable, compile an appeal that references clause C-2025-SLEEP-STUDY-PREAUTH (section 4.4) and attach the already‑satisfied retroactive authorization request (evidence code RETRO_AUTH_REQUEST) along with any supporting medical‑necessity notes.
The inpatient‑preauth precedent (F-INPATIENT-RETRO) does not apply because it governs inpatient services under clause C-2025-INPATIENT-PREAUTH, not sleep‑study services.
The MRI‑preauth precedent (F-MRI-REFERRAL) is unrelated; it is tied to clause C-2025-MRI-PREAUTH for MRI procedures, not to sleep‑study authorization.
The sleep‑study retroactive‑auth precedent (F-SLEEP-RETRO) has been contradicted by rules R-HC-010 and R-HC-011, so it cannot be relied on for this appeal.
There is no gate limiting appeal grounds, but the appeal must be submitted within the policy’s standard appeal window (see policy version V2025).
